Submitted Biological Question (untrusted input)

Analyze paired-end raw bulk RNA-seq FASTQ libraries from primary human airway smooth muscle cells treated with dexamethasone versus untreated controls across four matched human donor lines (GEO GSE52778 / ENA SRP033351, Homo sapiens hg38). Identify differentially expressed genes for dexamethasone versus untreated using a paired donor-blocked design.

Executive Summary

ARIA completed the submitted analysis. 7 findings were recorded across all modalities, of which 0 reached HIGH confidence. See the governed claim ledger below for published results.

Bulk contrast dexamethasone vs untreated success / medium Evidence scope: association only

Bulk contrast dexamethasone vs untreated identified 22 differentially expressed genes (19 higher and 3 lower in the numerator group). The strongest reported genes include GPX3 (log2FC 3.535), SAMHD1 (log2FC 3.578), GLUL (log2FC 2.87), ADAMTS1 (log2FC 2.093), CXCL12 (log2FC -2.041), FKBP5 (log2FC 4.334).

Preranked GSEA dexamethasone vs untreated used the full log2FC-ranked gene list and found 6 pathway(s) at the standard exploratory GSEA threshold of FDR < 0.25. The top ranked signals were Translation (GO:0006412) (NES=-3.9409, FDR=0.0409379), Positive Regulation Of Cell Population Proliferation (GO:0008284) (NES=-3.8843, FDR=0.0409379), Cytoplasmic Translation (GO:0002181) (NES=-3.8477, FDR=0.0409379).

Methods

**Data processing**

Genomic analyses were performed on Homo sapiens data aligned to the hg38 reference assembly.

**Bulk RNA-seq**

Raw paired-end FASTQ reads were trimmed with fastp (default parameters, min read length 36 bp, Phred quality ≥ 20), retaining an average of 95.8% of reads across 8 samples. Per-sample MultiQC reports were generated.
Reads were aligned to the hg38 reference genome (Ensembl release 112) using STAR (2-pass mode) with --outSAMtype BAM SortedByCoordinate and --quantMode GeneCounts enabled. Gene-level counts were computed with featureCounts (subread) using the Ensembl GTF annotation; paired-end reads were counted as fragments.
Differential expression was performed with DESeq2 (via pydeseq2). Low-count genes (<10 counts in fewer than 25% of samples) were filtered. Cook's distance was used to refit outlier counts. Sample QC used PCA-based outlier detection (>2 SD from group centroid in PC1–PC2).
Significance thresholds: adjusted p-value &lt; 0.05 and |log2 fold-change| &gt; 1.0.
Approximate power to detect |log2FC| > 1.0 at adjusted alpha 0.05 ranged from 85% to 85% across contrasts, using a negative-binomial Wald approximation from replicate count, mean expression, and dispersion.
Over-representation analysis was performed locally with a hypergeometric test against versioned GO Biological Process, KEGG, and Reactome GMT libraries. Gene lists were not sent to Enrichr; Enrichr is opt-in only. Significance was defined as adjusted p-value < 0.05. ORA used the dataset-expressed background (4551-4551 genes across contrasts) as the enrichment universe. Gene-set releases recorded: GO_BP=2021; KEGG=2021; Reactome=2022.

**Reproducibility**
All 15 parameter decisions are logged in ARIA's institutional memory database with full justification. See Supplementary Appendix for the complete decisions log.
